rows.item: Winter settings: F1203K halved, PP Virgin fills; RPA40WB only
rows.change: James: "it should just be the F1203K move. During winter, we reduce the 1203 by half and increase 6502 to fill the blank. If anything else move, its probably very minor and might be due to the calculation with auger"; "i think we only do it on RPA40WB". Replaces the 5 Nov rule that took Tech's old same-season issue (which moved talc and color too and took the SE24 "Shortage of Talc" recipe). Now: the order's settings as issued (own last issue, else the line's newest); when that issue is from summer, F1203K goes to half by weight and PP Virgin F6502A takes up the weight; every other feeder prints as before. Weight-blender lines (SE24, SE43): F1203K 15 -> 8, virgin +7. Auger lines: the speeds as printed (highest raised to 90), F1203K halved, the virgin auger adds the same weight on its own calibration slope (virgin goes to 96-99); never above 100 (SE23 virgin 99 would go to 109: every speed x 0.92). Only RPA40WB products; sign blanks (SPA40WB) and others as issued.
